assertion_updates.evidence_summary: The rs6897932 C allele was associated with multiple-sclerosis susceptibility in European-ancestry family and case-control datasets; combined case-control OR for CC versus CT/TT was1.29.

assertion_updates.causal_directness: Disease association; does not itself establish molecular or disease causality.
assertion_updates.limitations: One publication with four datasets; cross-publication donor overlap unresolved. Recruited totals438+1077 cases and479+2725 controls differ from reported combined analysis1512cases/3184controls; discrepancy retained. Association remainsG1. Molecular assays measure minigene/PBMC RNA, not soluble or membrane protein. Primary-progressive subgroup n185 had P>0.30 and stated25%power; this null does not establish absence. No independent numeric prior increments inferred.
